import json, os

item = _items[0]["json"]
slug = item["slug"]
regen = item.get("regen_ids") or []
shot_filter = set(item.get("shot_ids") or [])
root = "/home/node/files/films/" + slug
script_path = os.path.join(root, "script.json")
if not os.path.exists(script_path):
    raise RuntimeError("project not found: " + root + " — run the Script stage first")
with open(script_path) as fh:
    script = json.load(fh)
videos_dir = os.path.join(root, "videos")
os.makedirs(videos_dir, exist_ok=True)
camera_phrases = {
    "zoom_in": "slow dolly push-in toward the subject",
    "zoom_out": "slow pull-back revealing more of the scene",
    "pan_left": "smooth camera pan to the left",
    "pan_right": "smooth camera pan to the right",
    "auto": "subtle cinematic camera drift",
}
jobs = []
skipped = 0
missing = 0
for scene in script.get("scenes", []):
    for shot in scene.get("shots", []):
        sid = shot["id"]
        if shot_filter and sid not in shot_filter:
            continue
        png = os.path.join(root, "shots", sid + ".png")
        if not os.path.exists(png):
            missing += 1
            continue
        if os.path.exists(os.path.join(videos_dir, sid + ".mp4")) and sid not in regen:
            skipped += 1
            continue
        hint = shot.get("duration_hint_sec") or 5
        try:
            raw = max(4, min(8, int(round(float(hint)))))
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            raw = 5
        valid = (4, 6, 8)  # Veo 3.1 Lite supported durations
        duration = min(valid, key=lambda v: (abs(v - raw), -v))  # tie-break: prefer longer clip
        motion = shot.get("motion") if shot.get("motion") in camera_phrases else "auto"
        prompt = (shot.get("image_prompt") or "cinematic scene").strip()
        prompt += " Camera: " + camera_phrases[motion] + "."
        prompt += " Keep character faces, hair, and outfits identical to the input image."
        prompt += " Cinematic lighting, no text overlays."
        jobs.append({
            "shotId": sid,
            "pngPath": png,
            "prompt": prompt,
            "duration": duration,
            "resolution": item.get("resolution") or "720p",
            "aspect_ratio": item.get("aspect_ratio") or "16:9",
            "model": item.get("model") or "google/veo-3.1-lite",
        })
return [{"json": {"slug": slug, "jobs": jobs, "skipped": skipped, "missing_images": missing}}]

import base64, json, os, subprocess

ANIM_WIDTH = 1280
ANIM_HEIGHT = 720
JPEG_QUALITY = "4"
out = []
for it in _items:
    j = it.get("json", {})
    inner = j.get("item")
    job = inner if isinstance(inner, dict) else j
    png = job.get("pngPath")
    if not png or not os.path.exists(png):
        continue
    tmp_jpg = png[:-4] + "_anim.jpg"
    pr = subprocess.run(
        ["ffmpeg", "-y", "-loglevel", "error", "-i", png,
         "-vf", "scale=%d:%d:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,crop=%d:%d" % (ANIM_WIDTH, ANIM_HEIGHT, ANIM_WIDTH, ANIM_HEIGHT),
         "-q:v", JPEG_QUALITY, tmp_jpg],
        capture_output=True, text=True)
    if pr.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError("ffmpeg downscale failed for " + png + ": " + (pr.stderr or "")[-200:])
    with open(tmp_jpg, "rb") as fh:
        url = "data:image/jpeg;base64," + base64.b64encode(fh.read()).decode("ascii")
    os.remove(tmp_jpg)
    body = {
        "model": job.get("model") or "bytedance/seedance-2.0-fast",
        "prompt": job.get("prompt") or "cinematic scene",
        "aspect_ratio": job.get("aspect_ratio") or "16:9",
        "duration": job.get("duration") or 5,
        "resolution": job.get("resolution") or "720p",
        "generate_audio": true,
        "frame_images": [{"type": "image_url", "frame_type": "first_frame", "image_url": {"url": url}}],
    }
    out.append({"json": {"shotId": job.get("shotId"), "slug": job.get("slug"), "model": job.get("model"), "body": body}})
if not out:
    raise RuntimeError("no valid shot images found for animation")
return out

import datetime, glob, json, os, subprocess

# Idempotent: derives the full stage state from the videos directory on every
# run, so multiple loop waves converging through the merge each leave correct
# project.json state (the last wave wins with the complete truth).
MIN_VALID_MP4_BYTES = 1024  # smaller files are stale garbage (e.g. decoded binary-storage markers)

items = _items
slug = next((it["json"].get("slug") for it in items if it["json"].get("slug")), "")
if not slug:
    raise RuntimeError("slug missing in video results — cannot locate project")
root = "/home/node/files/films/" + slug
videos_dir = os.path.join(root, "videos")
with open(os.path.join(root, "script.json")) as fh:
    script = json.load(fh)
all_shot_ids = [s["id"] for sc in script.get("scenes", []) for s in sc.get("shots", [])]

now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat() + "Z"
mp4_paths = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(videos_dir, "shot_*.mp4")))
existing = set()
garbage = set()
for p in mp4_paths:
    sid = os.path.basename(p)[:-4]
    if sid not in all_shot_ids:
        continue
    if os.path.getsize(p) < MIN_VALID_MP4_BYTES:
        garbage.add(sid)  # unplayable leftover — report as missing so a regen replaces it
        continue
    existing.add(sid)
failed_ids = sorted((set(all_shot_ids) - existing) | garbage)

durations = {}
for p in mp4_paths:
    sid = os.path.basename(p)[:-4]
    if sid not in existing:
        continue
    pr = subprocess.run(
        ["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-show_entries", "format=duration", "-of", "csv=p=0", p],
        capture_output=True, text=True,
    )
    if pr.returncode == 0:
        durations[sid] = round(float(pr.stdout.strip()), 2)

model = next((it["json"].get("model") for it in items if it["json"].get("model")), "")
pf = os.path.join(root, "project.json")
proj = json.load(open(pf)) if os.path.exists(pf) else {}
prev_model = ((proj.get("stages") or {}).get("videos") or {}).get("model") or ""
proj["updated_at"] = now
proj.setdefault("stages", {})["videos"] = {
    "status": "done" if existing else "failed",
    "done_at": now,
    "count": len(existing),
    "total": len(all_shot_ids),
    "model": model or prev_model or "google/veo-3.1-lite",
    "failed_ids": failed_ids,
    "durations": durations,
}
with open(pf, "w") as fh:
    json.dump(proj, fh, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
return [{"json": {"ok": True, "slug": slug, "written": len(existing), "count": len(existing), "failed_ids_text": ", ".join(failed_ids)}}]
